prompt: Wire light 1 so either button 1 or button 2 turns it on.
note: Extra: both buttons released again at the end -> light 1 off. The reference asserts off only at power-on, before any press, so a circuit that latches the light on (a relay holding itself in) would pass it.

extra.cite: BK1 printed p.11 = book1.pdf PDF p.13; derived, not printed: neither pushbutton pushed after the presses. The page prints this state at power-on only; no N.O. contact is closed, so light 1 has no path from +
extra.quote: The light does not come on because there is not a closed circuit.
